mcat_name_audit.reason: "Smoking Cabin" is the highest-frequency primary keyword confirmed across Agent 3 alt_names and buyer_intent_queries, and aligns with dominant Indian B2B market usage for prefabricated ventilated smoking enclosures.

reason: The image correctly shows a prefabricated, glass-and-aluminium-framed enclosed smoking cabin with visible ventilation unit and ashtray stand — accurately representing the primary segment of ventilated workplace/public-space smoking enclosures.

The unit depicted appears to be a branded Euromate 'Smoke n Go' product with a visible brand poster inside, which introduces a seller/brand watermark-adjacent element; a generic, unbranded cabin render would be a stronger neutral category thumbnail.

mcat_image_suggestions.prompt_for_generation: A photorealistic product-style image of a freestanding prefabricated smoking cabin on a clean white background. The cabin has clear tempered glass panels, a silver/grey aluminium frame, a sliding glass entry door, a ceiling-mounted mechanical exhaust ventilation unit visible on top, a stainless steel ashtray pedestal inside, and interior bench seating. The structure is multi-person sized, fully enclosed, and unbranded. Soft studio lighting, slight three-quarter front angle to show both the door and side panel, sharp focus, professional B2B catalogue aesthetic.
